According to the github page you can decrypt the free files using the following commands:

gpg --decrypt --output eqgrp-free-file.tar.xz eqgrp-free-file.tar.xz.gpg

Using password: theequationgroup

Obviously, you're going to need a linux box with gpg installed in order to run this command.
